newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks slip after Chicago PMI, home sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks slip after Chicago PMI, home sales.

text.p: Wall Street stocks, which opened higher, declined on Monday after a higher-than-expected reading in the Chicago Purchasing Managers Index for June and a rise in U.S. single-family home sales in May.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell around 51 points or 0.66 percent to 7,637, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index-arbitrage trading at 1402 GMT.
Stocks were partly dragged down by a weaker bond market, which dropped 19/32 to a 6.79 percent yield.
The Nasdaq composite shed around three points to 1,435.
